summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: White House and Anthropic hold 'productive' meeting amid fears over Mythos model
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Webinar: From phishing to fallout — Why MSPs must rethink both security and recovery
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
